brief:
Israeli government embassies are distributing an online film designed to echo the style of NAZA, an award-winning documentary about mass killings of Gaza civilians, The Guardian reported. The hastily produced project mimics the format of the real Guardian documentary as part of a promotional campaign.

Details about the film's content, production timeline, and the specific embassies involved in its distribution were not immediately available.
